verified_files.code_fact: Worker queue config patched with extended retry budget (maxAttempts: 15, maxTimeoutInMs: 60000) allowing 9-10 minutes of outage resilience.
#handleTriggerScheduledTaskJob passes actual finalAttempt: job.attempt >= job.maxAttempts to triggerScheduledTask.
onTriggerScheduledTask supplies options: { idempotencyKey: `${scheduleInstanceId}:${exactScheduleTime.toISOString()}` } to triggerService.call, enforcing atomic deduplication.
Self-healing periodic background reconciliation (recoverSchedulesInEnvironment) scans active schedules on a 60s timer using enqueueOnce, automatically restoring dropped chains.
